term_end.label: End of term
term_end.action: Decide on continuing with {cp} before {date}: renew by negotiation, exit in an orderly way, or move to another supplier.
term_end.if_nothing: The engagement will end or renew under the agreement, without a decision from us.

auto_renewal.label: Automatic renewal
auto_renewal.action: Check whether renewing with {cp} on {date} is still wanted, and act by the notice date in the agreement.
auto_renewal.if_nothing: The agreement will renew by itself for another term.

nonrenewal_notice.label: Non-renewal notice
nonrenewal_notice.action: Decide by {act_by} whether to continue with {cp}. If not, give written notice by {date}{notice} and keep proof of delivery.
nonrenewal_notice.if_nothing: The agreement will renew automatically, and the chance to exit or change terms will close until the next cycle.

termination_convenience.label: Termination without cause
termination_convenience.action: The right to end the agreement with {cp} is available from {date}. Decide whether to use it.

termination_cause.label: Termination for breach
termination_cause.action: Check the cure period with {cp} and act before {date}.
termination_cause.if_nothing: The right to terminate may weaken or lapse.

post_term.label: Obligation after the end
post_term.action: Make sure the obligation after the end toward {cp} is met: {title}.
post_term.if_nothing: Risk of breaching a duty that survives the end of the agreement.

option_extend.label: Extension option
option_extend.action: Decide by {act_by} whether to exercise the option with {cp}. Exercise by written notice by {date}{notice}.
option_extend.if_nothing: The option will lapse, and continuing will need new consent from the other side.

option_other.label: Purchase or expansion option
option_other.action: Decide by {act_by} whether to exercise with {cp}. Exercise by written notice by {date}{notice}.
option_other.if_nothing: The right will lapse and can no longer be exercised.

first_refusal.label: Right of first refusal
first_refusal.action: Reply to {cp} within the response days in the agreement.
first_refusal.if_nothing: The right will lapse for the current offer.

claim_window.label: Deadline for a claim
claim_window.action: Send the notice or claim to {cp} within the period in the agreement{notice}.
claim_window.if_nothing: The right to claim will lapse.

price_adjustment.label: Price update or indexation
price_adjustment.action: Review the update with {cp} on {date} under the agreement, and check for a right to object or exit.
price_adjustment.if_nothing: The new price will take effect as given, without a review on our side.

payment_milestone.label: Payment
payment_milestone.action: Make sure the payment to {cp} is made by {date}.
payment_milestone.if_nothing: Late payment may lead to late interest and a ground for suspension or cancellation.

minimum_commitment.label: Minimum commitment or settlement
minimum_commitment.action: Check that the target with {cp} is met before the measurement period ends on {date}.
minimum_commitment.if_nothing: Missing the target may trigger the consequence set in the agreement.

payment_report.label: Report for payment
payment_report.if_nothing: Risk of breaching the reporting duty.

guarantee_expiry.label: Guarantee expiry
guarantee_expiry.action: Extend the guarantee or give {cp} a new one before {date}, and leave time for the bank.
guarantee_expiry.if_nothing: Having no valid guarantee may be a breach and lead to the guarantee being called.

insurance_cert.label: Insurance certificate
insurance_cert.action: Renew the certificate of insurance and send it to {cp} by {date}.
insurance_cert.if_nothing: Having no valid certificate may breach the insurance duty.

deposit_release.label: Deposit release
deposit_release.action: Ask {cp} to release the deposit on time.
deposit_release.if_nothing: The money stays with the other side.

periodic_report.label: Periodic report
periodic_report.action: Make sure the report from {cp} arrives by {date}, and check what it says.
periodic_report.if_nothing: We will not know whether the other side meets its obligation.

audit_window.label: Audit
audit_window.action: Decide by {date} whether to use the audit right with {cp}, and set a date.
audit_window.if_nothing: The audit right will not be used in this cycle.

condition_precedent.label: Condition precedent
condition_precedent.action: Make sure the condition with {cp} is met by {date}.
condition_precedent.if_nothing: Under the agreement, if the condition is not met, the agreement may be cancelled or its start delayed.

change_of_control.label: Change of control
change_of_control.action: Notify {cp} or get its consent before the change of control.
change_of_control.if_nothing: Risk of breach, and of a right for the other side to end the agreement.
